title: Sweet Potato Mochi Balls
summary: These sweet potato mochi balls are soft, chewy, and made with just 3 simple ingredients! An easy snack you can bake or air fry.
ingredients: 50 grams glutinous rice flour or tapioca flour (see note)
2-3 tablespoons honey or maple syrup (see note)
steps: Cook the sweet potatoes until fork-tender, then mash until completely smooth. Let cool before making the dough. Do this in advance if you can!
Add the mashed sweet potatoes, tapioca flour, and optional sweetener to a mixing bowl. Stir until combined. Add milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, until a soft, pliable dough forms.
Scoop out small portions of dough and roll between your palms into evenly sized balls.
Bake air fry at 350°F for 12-15 minutes or in the oven for 15-20 minutes.
